structured_inference.analysis: WHAT WE KNOW: The pH data comes from direct real-time USGS sensor readings for the entire 15-day period. We have a consistent reading of 7.6 across all timestamps. Alkalinity has no sensor data, so we cannot estimate its value. WHY THE ESTIMATE: This consistency in pH values gives us high confidence that the actual pH is around 7.6. WHAT IT MEANS: A pH of 7.6 is slightly alkaline, similar to tap water. Safe for most fish. CONFIDENCE REASON: Our confidence in this estimate comes from the consistent and reliable direct sensor readings over a prolonged period. KEY TAKEAWAY: The river segment at COMID 1777616 has a stable and safe pH of around 7.6.
